dog.description_text: Sweet as can be, meet Praline! This 3 month old, 13 lb Hound mix is a busy little bee with an attentive personality! Her foster mom she’s a great listener when it comes to her puppy manners, her crate training is going well and she’s working on her pottt training. She absolutely adores her dog foster brother Louie and is fostered with kids! Praline is getting smarter by the day, and can’t wait to grow in a forever home that is excited to raise a puppy! Kids yes, Cats yes, Dogs yes! She started her puppy vaccines and is spayed.
dog.name: Praline
